description: Wizzair's route map: pass a station IATA code to list its direct connections (city, country, is_new), or omit it to list every Wizzair city with its destination count. Cached for 6 hours. Data comes live from Wizzair's private booking API (unofficial — may briefly fail if Wizzair rotates or throttles it). Result shape: { source, fetchedAt, query, mode, count, route_map_url, ... }. With station: mode='single_station', station, station_name, country, connections: [{ iata, city, country, is_new }]. Without: mode='all_cities', cities: [{ iata, city, country, country_code, destinations }]. The list key is `connections` (or `cities`), never `routes`.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh Wizzair fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

station.description: Station IATA code to list connections from (e.g. WAW). Omit to list all Wizzair cities.

name: wizzair_search_routes
title: Wizzair route network
